D: Sam Flynn goes looking for his missing father and is pulled into the digital world his dad created.
P: Serve the snacks when Sam walks into his dad's old arcade.
S: Crisp oven fries smothered in quick beef chilli and hot cheddar sauce, finished with spring onion and pickled jalapeños, eaten straight from the tray. Bake 1kg frozen fries at 220C for 25 minutes until crisp. Brown 250g beef mince with half a diced onion, 1 tsp cumin and 1 tsp chilli powder, add 200g passata and simmer 10 minutes. Melt 20g butter, stir in 1 tbsp flour, whisk in 250ml milk until thick and stir in 120g grated cheddar. Pile the fries on a tray, spoon over the chilli and cheese sauce, and scatter with spring onion and jalapeños.
Pretzel rods dipped in white chocolate and piped with thin blue icing lines
Pretzel rods dipped in white chocolate and drizzled with neon blue icing lines, set on baking paper.
Dark rye squares with crème fraîche, smoked salmon, dill and lemon
Smoked salmon on black rye with crème fraîche and dill, laid out on black slate.
M: Chicken roasted with lemon, garlic and thyme at 200C for 75 minutes, carved with roast potatoes and greens, served on white plates. Mix 40g soft butter with 2 crushed garlic cloves, lemon zest and thyme and rub over and under the skin of a 1.8kg chicken. Stuff with the halved lemon. Roast at 200C for 75 minutes. Parboil 1kg potatoes, rough them up and roast in oil for 50 minutes alongside. Rest the chicken 10 minutes. Steam 2 bunches green beans and toss in butter. Carve and serve on white plates with the pan juices.
Stir fried chicken thigh, red capsicum, broccoli and egg noodles
Egg noodles stir-fried with chicken, capsicum and broccoli in a sticky soy and honey sauce.
W: End of Line Club neon cookies
Butter cookies cut into squares and iced
Crisp butter cookies iced in bright neon colours with sharp straight lines like the Grid.
K: Flynn's zen iced matcha with honey
Whisked matcha with honey, over ice

Matcha whisked smooth with warm water and honey, poured over ice and cold milk so it settles in a green layer, calm as Flynn. Sift 4 tsp matcha powder into a bowl and whisk with 200ml water at about 80C and 2 tbsp honey until smooth and frothy, with no lumps. Fill 4 glasses with ice and add 150ml cold milk to each. Slowly pour the matcha over the top so it sits in a bright green layer. Stir before drinking.

s.note: Pretzel rods dipped in white chocolate and piped with thin blue icing lines
s.how: Melt 200g white chocolate and dip 20 pretzel rods two-thirds of the way. Set on baking paper. Mix icing sugar with a little water and blue colouring and pipe thin straight lines along each rod like light cycle trails. Let set before serving.

s.note: Dark rye squares with crème fraîche, smoked salmon, dill and lemon
s.how: Cut dark rye bread into neat squares. Spread with crème fraîche and top with a fold of smoked salmon, a sprig of dill and a tiny squeeze of lemon. Lay them out in sharp rows on black slate, as clean as a nightclub inside a computer.

m.note: Stir fried chicken thigh, red capsicum, broccoli and egg noodles
m.how: Stir-fry 500g sliced chicken thighs in a hot wok until browned. Add a sliced red capsicum and broccoli florets and cook 3 minutes. Toss through 400g cooked egg noodles with 3 tbsp soy sauce and 2 tbsp honey until sticky and glossy.

w.n: End of Line Club neon cookies
w.note: Butter cookies cut into squares and iced
w.how: Beat 200g butter with 100g icing sugar, add 1 egg yolk, then 300g plain flour. Roll, cut into squares and bake at 170C for 12 minutes. Ice with 250g icing sugar mixed with water and neon food colouring in straight lines.
